note: Analyst labels for adjudication groups (PREREG-TRACKER §5), written after scoring from each group's evidence and the builds' practice effects (experiments/tracker-v2/explain.mjs). label: true (the build does not do what the person's words say) | oracle-gap (true per the words; the hidden-world oracle does not check it) | false (the check fails although the person's words are met). cause names the root cause of a false alarm (RESULT-TRACKER.md §5).

causes.unstated-qualifier: the person's words omit a qualifier any sensible build (and the oracle) applies: unsubscribed contacts, receipts, already-paid items; the literal check calls the sensible build wrong
causes.object-name: the check selects a system object by the person's name for it (sheet 'mailing list') where the system's name differs ('newsletter')
causes.state-vs-effect: the words ask for a state ('the list has everyone'); the check counts new effects, so an item already in that state reads as missed
causes.binding: the binder chose a template or a filter the words do not support (a strict count for a 'when', a once-only rule nobody stated, an excluded group included)
causes.closed-world: a scope check's 'no other item is ever named' half from words with no exclusive cue
causes.rules-overlap: two of the person's rules both claim the item; the build followed the other one
causes.keyword-category: the person's category ('asks about shipping') bound to a keyword in free text; the item has the keyword but not the category, or the category without the keyword
causes.scenario-chimera: a synthesized practice row built by appending a filter keyword to another row's text; its category is ambiguous by construction
causes.evaluator-names: an item 'named' by a common word of its free text ('Thanks!'), so unrelated effects count as acting on it
causes.over-literal: content the person described ('what's done', 'alerts', 'open mon-sat 9-6') required as literal words
causes.selector-it: 'sign it' applied to every message, including ones to the person's own inbox
causes.boundary-ambiguity: a synthesized row exactly on an edge the words leave open ('from the last 24h' at exactly 24 h)
causes.contradictory: the check fixes one effect field twice: to the item's own value (link) and to a literal (require), so no effect can ever pass
